messages:
olivia: T-minus 30 for the 'tunnel' cutover (routing + small DB migration). Quick preflight checklist — please ack and call out owners for smoke + rollback.

olivia: Checklist:
- [ ] Deploy owner (who runs the rollout)
- [ ] Smoke owner (who verifies 200s + perf)
- [ ] Rollback owner (who triggers revert if needed)
- [ ] DB migration dry-run ✅
- [ ] Config flag name and toggle confirmed
- [ ] Health checks / probe endpoints + log snippets to watch
- [ ] Communication channel: this thread (and #oncall if pager needed)

sanjay: I can be deploy owner. I’ll run the canary then roll to 30%.

lucy: I’ll own smoke. I’ll validate chat paths + latency dashboards. Will run the smoke script `scripts/smoke/tunnel-check.sh` and post results.

kevin: Rollback owner here. If errors > 2% or error-rate spike on /api/chat we revert routes and flip `feature.tunnel_enabled` to false. I’ll coordinate the revert.

maria: Need the config flag exact key and the migration SQL path.

olivia: Flag is `feature.tunnel_enabled`. Migration SQL: `migrations/2026_03_tunnel_add_idx.sql`. Dry-run was green on staging at 14:12 UTC.

olivia: Deploy command (local ops):
```
./deploy --service tunnel-router --image gcr/redwood/tunnel:v3.1.0 --canary 1%
# after 10m: ./deploy --promote --traffic 30%
```

olivia: DB migrate (online-safe):
```
pg_dump -s -f pre_mig_schema.sql
psql -f migrations/2026_03_tunnel_add_idx.sql --set ON_ERROR_STOP=on
```

lucy: Smoke script excerpt:
```
curl -sS https://tunnel-int.redwood/api/health | jq .status
ab -n 200 -c 10 https://tunnel-int.redwood/api/chat
```
I’ll post latency p95/p99 and any traceback snippets.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy window: 2026-03-17T02:30:00Z -> 2026-03-17T03:00:00Z. Reminder will post at T-minus 15m.

sanjay: Confirmed. I’ll start at T-minus 30m, canary at T+5m.

maria: Quick Q — does the migration require a brief write lock on `chat_sessions`? I saw an index creation that might lock.

olivia: It’s an `CONCURRENTLY` index, no full table lock. Verified on staging. Still, monitor `pg_stat_activity` for long queries.

kevin: Rollback plan steps (short):
1) Flip envoy route back to previous pool
2) Set `feature.tunnel_enabled=false` in K/V store
3) Run `rollback-scripts/release-2026-03-revert.sh`
4) Notify infra and oncall

kevin: If I’m not responding within 5m during the window, run the revert script and notify #oncall.

lucy: Acked as smoke owner :white_check_mark:

maria: Ack flag + migration path. I’ll stand by for any schema anomalies.

sanjay: Starting canary now (1%). Logging will be posted to /deploys/tunnel/1799999000 in Kibana.

lucy: Smoke results (after canary):
- health OK: {"status":"ok"}
- p95 120ms, p99 320ms
- no 5xx in canary logs
Posting sample trace: `trace_id=abc123` — no errors.

sanjay: Promoting to 30% now.

olivia: DB migration running (concurrent idx). Monitoring pg_locks and long queries.

kevin: Watching metrics. Error-rate stable. Ready to run rollback if we see >2% errors.

lucy: Mid-roll smoke: p95 140ms, p99 340ms, minor increase but within SLA. :thumbsup:

sanjay: Rolling to 100% in 2m if no objections.

maria: No objections. :white_check_mark:

kevin: Standing by.

olivia: Rolling to 100% now. Will update after post-roll smoke.

lucy: Post-roll smoke (5m): p95 145ms, p99 360ms, 0.3% 5xx (transient), investigating logs; not actionable yet.

kevin: If 5xx exceeds 2% in next 10m I’ll kick revert. Currently OK.

olivia: Migration finished, no long locks, index created concurrently. Pre/post row counts match.

sanjay: Deploy complete. Thanks team. :tada:

lucy: Closing smoke check — everything good from my side. :white_check_mark:

olivia: Thanks all — leaving notes in the release doc and tagging infra for postmortem metrics.
